The '''8th  [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1950 in film|1950]] films, were held on February 28, 1951, in the [[Ciro's]] nightclub in  [[West Hollywood, California]], at 8433 [[Sunset Boulevard]], on the [[Sunset Strip]].

==Winners and Nominees==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture]]===
'' '''[[Sunset Boulevard (film)|Sunset Boulevard]]'''''<ref>{{cite web | title=Sunset Boulevard | website=Golden Globes | date=2023-10-25 | url=https://goldenglobes.com/film/sunset-boulevard/ | access-date=2025-11-02}}</ref><ref name="news1950"/>
*''[[All About Eve]]''
*''[[Born Yesterday (1950 film)|Born Yesterday]]''
*''[[Cyrano de Bergerac (1950 film)|Cyrano de Bergerac]]''
*''[[Harvey (1950 film)|Harvey]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture  - Drama]]===
'''  [[José Ferrer]] &ndash; ''[[Cyrano de Bergerac (1950 film)|Cyrano de Bergerac]]'''''<ref>{{cite web | title=José Ferrer | website=Golden Globes | date=2023-10-25 | url=https://goldenglobes.com/person/jose-ferrer/ | access-date=2025-11-02}}</ref><ref name="news1950">{{cite web | title=Gloria Swanson, Ferrer Awarded Golden Globes | website=Newspapers.com | date=1951-03-01 | url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/green-bay-press-gazette-gloria-swanson/51207680/ | access-date=2025-11-02}}</ref>
*[[Louis Calhern]] &ndash; ''[[The Magnificent Yankee (1950 film)|The Magnificent Yankee]]''
*[[James Stewart]] &ndash; ''[[Harvey (1950 film)|Harvey]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture - Drama]] ===
''' [[Gloria Swanson]] &ndash; ''[[Sunset Boulevard (film)|Sunset Boulevard]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[Bette Davis]] &ndash; ''[[All About Eve]]''
*[[Judy Holliday]] &ndash; ''[[Born Yesterday (1950 film)|Born Yesterday]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Fred Astaire]] &ndash; ''[[Three Little Words (film)|Three Little Words]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[Dan Dailey]] &ndash; ''[[When Willie Comes Marching Home]]''
*[[Harold Lloyd]] &ndash; ''[[Mad Wednesday]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Judy Holliday]] &ndash; ''[[Born Yesterday (1950 film)|Born Yesterday]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[Spring Byington]] &ndash; ''[[Louisa (film)|Louisa]]''
*[[Betty Hutton]] &ndash; ''[[Annie Get Your Gun (film)|Annie Get Your Gun]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Edmund Gwenn]] &ndash; ''[[Mister 880]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[George Sanders]] &ndash; ''[[All About Eve]]''
*[[Erich von Stroheim]] &ndash; ''[[Sunset Boulevard (1950 film)|Sunset Boulevard]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Josephine Hull]] &ndash; ''[[Harvey (1950 film)|Harvey]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[Judy Holliday]] &ndash; ''[[Adam's Rib]]''
*[[Thelma Ritter]] &ndash; ''[[All About Eve]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director - Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Billy Wilder]] &ndash; ''[[Sunset Boulevard (film)|Sunset Boulevard]]'''''<ref name="news1950"/>
*[[George Cukor]] &ndash; ''[[Born Yesterday (1950 film)|Born Yesterday]]''
*[[John Huston]] &ndash; ''[[The Asphalt Jungle]]''
*[[Joseph L. Mankiewicz]] &ndash; ''[[All About Eve]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay|Best Screenplay - Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[All About Eve]]'' &ndash; [[Joseph L. Mankiewicz]]'''
*''[[The Asphalt Jungle]]'' &ndash; [[John Huston]]
*''[[Sunset Boulevard (1950 film)|Sunset Boulevard]]'' &ndash; [[Charles Brackett]]

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score|Best Music, Original Score - Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[Sunset Boulevard (film)|Sunset Boulevard]]'' &ndash; [[Franz Waxman]]'''
*''[[A Life of Her Own]]'' &ndash; [[Bronislau Kaper]]
*''[[Destination Moon (film)|Destination Moon]]'' &ndash; [[Leith Stevens]]

*''[[Sunset Boulevard (1950 film)|Sunset Boulevard]]''
